LSU opens as 10-point favorite at Kentucky

Press Release
LSU Sports, LSU Football, Sports Betting, Top Stories
2d ago
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 2:46
Instaread

LSU hits the road in Week 6 as a double-digit favorite, with the Tigers laying 10 points at Kentucky. After surviving a challenging September at 3-1, Lane Kiffin’s team now enters a stretch where LSU will be expected to handle its business against the Wildcats. Elsewhere in the SEC, the marquee matchup is in Tuscaloosa, where Georgia and Alabama opened as a pick’em in another heavyweight showdown.
